command:
sh -c '
export PATH="$PATH:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"  # non-login SSH shells on RHEL 7 lack sbin
sec(){ printf '"'"'\n@@%s@@\n'"'"' "$1"; }
sec sshd_t; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/kanareika-collect sshd-config | grep -Ei '"'"'^(port|permitrootlogin|passwordauthentication|kbdinteractiveauthentication|challengeresponseauthentication|pubkeyauthentication|authorizedkeysfile|usepam|permitemptypasswords|allowusers|allowgroups|denyusers|listenaddress|maxauthtries) |denied|not permitted|error'"'"'
sec sshd_files; cat /etc/ssh/sshd_config /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei '"'"'^\s*(Port|PermitRootLogin|PasswordAuthentication|KbdInteractiveAuthentication|ChallengeResponseAuthentication|PubkeyAuthentication|AuthorizedKeysFile|UsePAM|PermitEmptyPasswords|AllowUsers|AllowGroups)\s'"'"'
sec passwd; awk -F: '"'"'{print $1":"$3":"$6":"$7}'"'"' /etc/passwd
sec sshd_users; for u in $(awk -F: '"'"'$7 !~ /(nologin|false|sync|shutdown|halt)$/ && $1 ~ /^[a-z_][a-z0-9_.-]*$/ {print $1}'"'"' /etc/passwd | head -n 30); do echo "U:$u"; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/kanareika-collect sshd-config-user "$u"; done
sec shadow_pw; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/kanareika-collect password-users 2>&1
sec keys; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/kanareika-collect authorized-keys
sec auth; sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/kanareika-collect auth-log
sec last; last -F -w -n 200 2>/dev/null | head -n 200
'
